name: Ticklhof am See
beschreibung: The Ticklhof am See is situated directly on the picturesque shores of Lake Thiersee in the Tyrolean district of Kufstein. The inn seamlessly combines traditional Tyrolean warmth with an idyllic lakeside setting. Guests can savour regional culinary specialties in the restaurant and admire panoramic vistas of the lake and mountains from the terrace. Immediate access to hiking trails makes it an ideal starting point for exploring the scenic region.
